name: OneOrigin
about: Shared look of the OneOrigin tools, read by scripts/oneorigin.mjs build to write each tool's CSS variables. brand.md and guidelines.md explain the rules. Colors are per mode: light, then dark.

accent.use: Selection, fills, primary buttons. Not focus rings.

focus.use: Keyboard focus rings only. Owner's decision 2026-11-11: 4.6:1 or better on every light background.

brand-pink.use: The brand mark and highlights only.

structure.use: Lines and connectors: brown in light mode.

background.use: The page, in every Mac app.

palette.about: The OneOrigin palette, approved by the owner 2026-11-12: four tool colors that form a tetradic rectangle, a shared teal for the one, a cream center and aubergine lines. The marks in marks/ use only these colors. brand.md explains the rules, and scripts/oneorigin.test.mjs checks the colorblind and contrast numbers.

the-one.use: The one: the selected rank, the sample, the person, the animal, the suite's origin. Always with a cream center.

lines.use: Lines and joins in the marks: aubergine, pale on dark backgrounds.

card.use: Cards and panels, with a soft shadow.

icon-size.use: Line icons, drawn from Lucide, with a 1.75 stroke (icon.line).

line.use: Interface line icons: round caps and joins, currentColor.

tile-small.use: brand/icon-small.svg, for 16 to 32 px, without the badge.
